supersedes_as_new_experiment: r3 is preserved byte-for-byte; r4 changes memory service resources and candidate datapath, so ratios cannot mix r3 and r4

production.parameters: SCHEDULE_MODE=1; all other defaults unchanged, including G48 and B4
production.order: B4 contains four adjacent spatial positions; ten B4 transactions cover T10 per quad
production.load: Only nonempty group descriptors, ascending group; one zero terminal descriptor for an empty context
production.return_port: m803 c modulo 8 remains unchanged; this is not the captured backing bank

candidate.order: four complete-T positions per quad; eight independent canonical-bank FSMs, each processing its 48 sources in ascending original c; cross-bank order may differ
candidate.outstanding: One request per bank engine, eight concurrently; each response owned by engine/epoch/generation/slot/tag
candidate.mode_authority: One layer-common mode fixed by prior same-sample first-256-position calibration, not retuned on positions256..287
candidate.direct: Each accepted coefficient vector is stored then one APPLY cycle simultaneously updates all active T10 private Y vectors; no extra copy or serial temporal scatter
candidate.shared: Each selected source updates the bank-local shared partial in one APPLY cycle; its last member pays an additional FLUSH cycle to update all selected T private Y vectors in parallel
candidate.same_structure: direct/shared are the same RTL with sharing disabled/enabled, including allocated partials, private Y, work registers, and final reducer
candidate.remaining_count: Computed while actual RTL source masks load; a selected mode emits only at its last local source
candidate.Y: Persistent Acc24 bank-private T10 by H96 RTL state, avoiding simultaneous writes from different banks
candidate.final_reduction: After every bank finishes, one 16-lane reducer visits all eight banks for each of60 time/slice vectors; first valid value is assigned, later valid values added; all visits, arithmetic, output backpressure and acceptance are clocked

address_service.row_contents: 16 source channels by96 output channels, signed diagnostic numerator in each32-bit backing word
address_service.queues: FIFO per canonical bank, up to8 pending metadata entries; global ownership restricts each of8 return ports to one outstanding request, at most8 total
address_service.admission: Up to8 return-port requests accepted per cycle subject to ownership and queue capacity; same service on all three axes
address_service.responses: Each bank holds one16-lane INT8 response until destination return port accepts it; no conflicting response ownership
address_service.parallelism: Eight independent128-bit bank services, including row fetch/extract; no free single-cycle row fill or eight-port read of one bank
address_service.mapped_adapter: Canonical row fetch and32-bit-to-INT8 unpack are behavioral service, not synthesized hardware
address_service.shared_with_production: All three axes have identical external row cache/port/queue service resources; internal RTL resources differ

candidate_raw_state_bytes.extra_state: 480 Y-valid bits, eight partial-live bits,8x6 remaining-count bits, source counters, FSMs, generation/tag/epoch, output control and activity counters; not hidden in sum
candidate_raw_state_bytes.arithmetic_ports: Each bank can update10 independent16-lane temporal Y vectors per APPLY/FLUSH cycle; eight banks may do so concurrently. Shared partial has one16-lane update per bank. Final reducer has16 lanes. These are behavioral RTL parallel operations, not a mapped ALU count or PPA claim
candidate_raw_state_bytes.production_internal_state_reference: Original m2018 has four96-lane Acc24 contexts (1152B) and four1536B INT8 weight-cache entries (6144B), plus masks/tags/control; candidate storage is not asserted equal

arithmetic.stored_numerator: 9*weight, signed INT8; represented contribution is numerator/8

producer.implementation: Behavioral source DMA availability plus RTL descriptor/signature loading
producer.production_availability: T0 can start after12 cycles, later T becomes available every12 cycles
producer.candidate_availability: FullT signatures are usable after120 cycles
producer.packing_compute_cycles: Unimplemented and excluded; charged availability and loading do not prove producer closure

timing.start: first modeled source transfer cycle after reset per quad
timing.end: edge accepting final downstream Acc24 vector
timing.reset: Each quad starts reset and cold; reset cycles excluded; all between-transaction load/retirement included
timing.backpressure: bridge_ready=(cycle modulo11 !=3); commit_ready=(cycle modulo13 !=5); responses hold until accepted
timing.report: Same-r4 service cycle sums only, per-bank row/vector counts, maximum owned requests/queues, multi-bank service cycles, candidate simultaneous bank/T updates, additions including final reduction, and shared/direct increment

consumer.implemented: Candidate persistent Y and final cross-bank reduction are RTL; C++ verifies all outputs against independent direct integer golden
consumer.output_store: At most one accepted16-lane output vector per cycle; external writeback DMA excluded

gates: Frozen fixtures identical on all axes
All30720 scalar outputs per axis match, with no missing/duplicate coordinates
No early bank-slot reuse or response collision
Eight-bank concurrency measured rather than inferred from array count
Failed attempts retained with source snapshots
